info.title: LedgerFlow API
info.description: Personal access tokens (Settings, API tokens): `Authorization: Bearer lf_…`. A token has an owner, scopes that never go beyond the rights of the owner, an expiry and a rate (60 requests a minute unless set otherwise; `RateLimit-*` headers on every answer). Errors are `application/problem+json`. Lists are paged by cursor (`page[size]`, `page[after]`), filtered by `filter[name]` and sorted by `sort`. An update needs the `ETag` of the resource in `If-Match`; a POST accepts an `Idempotency-Key`. Entries are created as drafts, validated by an explicit call, and reversed, never changed once validated.
